contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

An silver early medieval Merovingian denier of a previously unrecorded type, c.AD 700-40, possibly Chalon-sur-Saone. The reverse may be related to De Belfort 6582 and 6514, both of unassigned mint.
